confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge, not live listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation anchors are less certain because Hue lodging rates vary widely by district and season. Cocktail and wine are bounded by the local beer relationship, since direct knowledge of bar prices is weaker. The FX value comes from a search snippet of the RBA exchange-rates page, which I did not open directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Central Vietnam domestic tourism cities such as Hoi An and Da Nang, adjusted downward for Hue's generally lower visitor price levels. Cocktail and wine were set relative to beer, as the local price relationship allows.
